content: Transfer Learning. Several recent breakthroughs in MRC benefit from feature-based transfer learning BIBREF26 , BIBREF27 and fine-tuning-based transfer learning BIBREF28 , BIBREF29 , which are based on certain word-level or sentence-level models pre-trained on large external corpora in certain supervised or unsupervised manners.
